example_normalisations.normalisation: Restored the missing closing root-object brace; captured values unchanged.

request_notes: Single anonymous URI wildcards map to their sole declared path parameter. No ordering is guessed for multiple wildcards.
GET agreement signing, asset collection, baseline-policy deletion and web-protection alarm deletion are confirmed non-retryable mutations.
Two captured top-level array request bodies use UTF-8 JSON file inputs; their arrays must not be wrapped in named objects.
Encoded directory and antivirus path inputs retain the upstream reverse-string then Base64 wire requirement; no unrequested shell script is executed.

supplemental_evidence.observation: The older lowercase tamperproof/config URI names currentNum then pageSize; the current API 5181 table lists pageSize then currentNum and publishes only anonymous wildcards. The older response/signing contract also differs, so it cannot establish the current contract.
The current public guide also omits named path positions and URL examples.
The current public guide likewise has no response schema and only an empty object example.

notes: The required baseline policy input identifies its current scan status; configuration queries expose documented Boolean or binary switch states.
Weak-password, antivirus and vulnerability scan summaries do not select a particular task; no task-completion waiter is inferred.

The export query accepts either exportTaskId or exportType. Current waiter metadata cannot require a scalar identity on this object response only while polling; no type-only latest-task waiter is added.

response_notes: Successful envelopes require statusCode 200 and the documented CTCSSCN_000000 code. Sixteen operations also publish 0 in both the error-field schema example and captured successful response; accept 0 only on those operations, not as a product-wide alias.
Boolean and integer request examples written as strings are normalized to their explicit parameter types.
The quota statistics response is missing one final closing brace; repair punctuation only, preserving all values.
